annotations.description:
Unstructured key value map that may be set by external tools to
store and arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be
preserved when modifying objects.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_annotations' for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: Annotations are metadata with no direct security impact.

backend.description: The ID of the Backend that this Build applies to
backend.rationale: Backend ID is a reference with no direct security implications.

build_id.description: The user-specified ID of the build being created.
build_id.rationale: Build ID is an identifier with no direct security impact.

display_name.rationale: Output field with no security policy.

labels.description:
Unstructured key value map that can be used to organize and categorize
objects.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are metadata with no direct security impact.

location.description: The location of the Backend that this Build applies to
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project specification uses default provider project when not specified.

source.codebase.description:
A codebase source, representing the state of the codebase
that the build will be created at.

source.codebase.branch.description: The branch in the codebase to build from, using the latest commit.
source.codebase.branch.rationale: Branch specification has no security policy.

source.codebase.commit.description: The commit in the codebase to build from.
source.codebase.commit.rationale: Commit specification has no security policy.

source.container.description:
The URI of an Artifact Registry
[container
image](https://cloud.google.com/artifact-registry/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.repositories.dockerImages)
to use as the build source.

source.container.image.description: A URI representing a container for the backend to use.
source.container.image.rationale: References the container image deployed for the build. This is a pointer to an image in a team's registry; constraining it would require hardcoding a specific registry/project, which is overreaching, and it does not map to a generic security archetype.
